scripts.text:
[Prontera Guide]
Welcome to Prontera,
the beautiful capital of the
Rune-Midgarts Kingdom. If
you have questions or need help finding something in the city, don't hesitate to ask.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉向導]
歡迎來到普隆德拉，盧恩·米德加茲王國美麗的首都。
如果有問題，或是需要城內的路線指引，請儘管問我。

scripts.text: City Guide.
scripts.translation: 城市導覽

scripts.text: Remove Marks from Mini-Map
scripts.translation: 移除小地圖示記

scripts.text: Notice
scripts.translation: 告示

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Prontera Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
Would you like me
to mark locations
on your Mini-Map?
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉向導]
請從以下選單中選擇一個地點。
需要我在您的小地圖上標記地點嗎？

scripts.text:
[Prontera Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉向導]
請從以下選單中選擇一個地點。

scripts.text:
[Prontera Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Prontera Guide]
The Swordman Association,
which handles Job Changes
to the Swordman class, has
moved to Izlude. This facility
is just an empty building now.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉向導]
請從以下選單中選擇一個地點。
[普隆德拉向導]
負責辦理劍士轉職手續的劍士協會已經搬到依斯魯得了。
這裡如今只剩下一棟空樓。

scripts.text:
[Prontera Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Prontera Guide]
The Prontera Sanctuary
handles Job Changes to
the Acolyte class, and can
be found in the northeast
corner of Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉向導]
請從以下選單中選擇一個地點。
[普隆德拉向導]
普隆德拉聖堂位於普隆德拉的東北角，負責辦理服事的轉職手續。

scripts.text:
[Prontera Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Prontera Guide]
The Prontera Chivralry,
which is responsible for
the safety of our capital, is
in Prontera's northwest corner.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉向導]
請從以下選單中選擇一個地點。
[普隆德拉向導]
負責守護首都安全的普隆德拉騎士團位於普隆德拉的西北角。

scripts.text:
[Prontera Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Prontera Guide]
The Weapon Shop
is located northeast
of the central fountain.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉向導]
請從以下選單中選擇一個地點。
[普隆德拉向導]
武器店位於中央噴泉的東北方。

scripts.text:
[Prontera Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Prontera Guide]
The Tool Shop
is located northwest
of the central fountain.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉向導]
請從以下選單中選擇一個地點。
[普隆德拉向導]
道具店位於中央噴泉的西北方。

scripts.text:
[Prontera Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Prontera Guide]
The Inns in Prontera are
located both to the east
and west of Prontera's
central fountain area.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉向導]
請從以下選單中選擇一個地點。
[普隆德拉向導]
普隆德拉的旅館分別位於中央噴泉區域的東側和西側。

scripts.text:
[Prontera Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Prontera Guide]
The Trading Post
can be found southeast
from the central fountain.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉向導]
請從以下選單中選擇一個地點。
[普隆德拉向導]
交易所位於中央噴泉的東南方。

scripts.text:
[Prontera Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Prontera Guide]
The Pub is located
southeast of the fountain,
behind the Trading Post.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉向導]
請從以下選單中選擇一個地點。
[普隆德拉向導]
酒館位於噴泉的東南方，就在交易所後面。

scripts.text:
[Prontera Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Prontera Guide]
If you head north from
the central fountain, you'll
find an empty area in which
both branches of the Prontera
Library can be accessed if you
head towards the east or west.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉向導]
請從以下選單中選擇一個地點。
[普隆德拉向導]
從中央噴泉往北走，您會看到一片空地。
再往東或往西走，就能分別找到普隆德拉圖書館的兩個分館。

scripts.text:
[Prontera Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Prontera Guide]
The Job Agency is
just southwest of the
central fountain area.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉向導]
請從以下選單中選擇一個地點。
[普隆德拉向導]
職業介紹所位於中央噴泉區域的西南方。

scripts.text:
[Prontera Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Prontera Guide]
The Prontera Castle is
located at the northern
sector of this city. You can
go to the fields that are north
of Prontera by going through
the castle's rear exit.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉向導]
請從以下選單中選擇一個地點。
[普隆德拉向導]
普隆德拉王宮位於城市北部。
穿過王宮的後門，就能前往普隆德拉北邊的野外。

scripts.text:
[Prontera Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Prontera Guide]
The City Hall
is located in the
southwest corner
in our city of Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉向導]
請從以下選單中選擇一個地點。
[普隆德拉向導]
市政廳位於普隆德拉城的西南角。

scripts.text:
[Prontera Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Prontera Guide]
Please ask me to ''Remove
Marks from Mini-Map'' if you
no longer wish to have the
location marks displayed
on your Mini-Map.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉向導]
請從以下選單中選擇一個地點。
[普隆德拉向導]
如果不想讓小地圖繼續顯示地點標記，請選擇“移除小地圖示記”。

scripts.translation: 是

scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Prontera Guide]
Advances in sorcery and
technology have allowed
us to update our information
system, enabling up to mark
locations on your Mini-Map
for easier navigation.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉向導]
魔法與科技的進步讓我們得以更新資訊系統，現在可以在您的小地圖上標記地點，方便您辨認方向。

scripts.text:
[Prontera Guide]
Your Mini-Map is located
in the upper right corner
of the screen. If you can't
see it, press the Ctrl + Tab
keys or click the ''Map'' button in your Basic Info Window.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉向導]
小地圖位於螢幕右上角。
如果看不到，請按Ctrl + Tab，或點選基本資訊視窗中的“地圖”按鈕。

scripts.text:
[Prontera Guide]
On your Mini-Map,
click on the ''+'' and ''-''
symbols to zoom in and
our of your Mini-Map. We
hope you enjoy your travels
here in the city of Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉向導]
點選小地圖上的“+”和“-”，就能放大或縮小地圖。
祝您在普隆德拉遊歷愉快。

scripts.text:
[Prontera Guide]
Well, adventurer...
I hope your journeys
through Rune-Midgarts
are both fun and safe.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉向導]
好了，冒險者...
願您在盧恩·米德加茲的旅程既愉快，又平安。
